answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tethered to locked capital. Like a juniper root gripping a rocky ridge, this economic bond ensures that an attacker cannot scale identities without proportional asset acquisition. By forcing entities to pay for participation in the digital orchard of the network, the cost of subverting consensus becomes economically irrational, as the attacker would destroy the value of their own staked collateral during any malicious attempt.
